bias.direction: conservative for B/C central sweeps: it suppresses all central strategies, so a local uplift should understate platform upside
bias.source: NPC model is too greedy and too central

design.A: same local 5x5 harvester; empty window returns to anchor and STAYs
design.B: same harvester; empty window alternates anchor and one inward neighbor with three LUT moves
design.C: same harvester; empty window cycles a four-cell 2x2 loop with three LUT moves
design.D: hard center mask: score only 9x9 center gold; if none, return/idle
design.D_prime: soft center-first mask: prefer center gold; allow outer gold only when no center gold is visible
design.dispatch: fixed; two seat-swapped legs per seed
design.mutual_block: requested non-STAY step became effective STAY and requested destination equaled friendly unit's then-current cell
design.rolling_coverage: for each unit and each 5-round end-position window, union of radius-2 non-wall cells
